subject: Post-demo: Vendor onboarding checklist & MAP (Ariba/Coupa steps)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Park <jill.park@clearwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + draft MAP: vendor onboarding (Ariba/Coupa, W-9, banking)

Hi Jill —

Thanks again for the demo time today. Great conversation and appreciate the clarity on ClearWave's timelines. Attached is a short draft of the Mutual Action Plan focusing on vendor onboarding milestones so we can align owners and target dates. High-level items below (please confirm owners/target dates):

1) Vendor packet & W-9 collection
   - Owner: ClearWave (Jill)
   - Target: 2027-04-27
   - Notes: W-9 + legal entity name + remit address

2) Ariba/Coupa supplier setup request
   - Owner: ClearWave procurement + VendorOps (Oliver)
   - Target: 2027-05-03
   - Dependencies: W-9 and EIN confirmed; bank details form in place

3) Banking details (ACH/Remit)
   - Owner: ClearWave finance
   - Target: 2027-04-30
   - Notes: send completed vendor_bank_details_form.xlsx

4) Redwood PO & contract signature
   - Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood)
   - Target: 2027-05-06
   - Dependencies: Ariba record or vendor code for invoicing, W-9 uploaded to procurement portal

5) Provisioning & test calls
   - Owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood Customer Success)
   - Target: 2027-05-10

Open questions / asks for ClearWave before our next sync:
- Can you confirm if you prefer Ariba or Coupa for supplier creation? (We will support either; need portal field examples.)
- Do you require a certified W-9 (signed) vs a digital copy?
- Who is the primary procurement contact for vendor onboarding (name/email)?

I attached the draft MAP (one page) and a suggested vendor bank form that ClearWave can fill out. If that looks right, can we book a 30-min procurement sync next week to walk through the Ariba/Coupa fields and confirm owners? Proposed time: Thu, Apr 22 at 10:00am PT.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Strategic Accounts (West)
Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: RW_MAP_ClearWave_v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: vendor_bank_details_form.xlsx (XLSX)]
From: Jill Park <jill.park@clearwave.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearwave.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + draft MAP: vendor onboarding (Ariba/Coupa, W-9, banking)

Tessa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP — much appreciated. Quick answers below and a couple of attachments.

- We use Coupa for supplier creation; I'll loop Oliver Kim from VendorOps (copied on separate email) who manages our Coupa intake.
- We'll upload a signed W-9 to our procurement portal. In the meantime, attached is our tax form.
- Primary procurement point: procurement@clearwave.com (and Oliver Kim, vendorops@clearwave.com).

Questions for Redwood:
- Do you have a standard Coupa template we can use to populate the supplier fields? If so, sending that in advance will speed up intake.
- For banking/ACH info, we will only accept a completed vendor bank form on company letterhead — is that okay?

I'll confirm dates internally but the targets you listed look feasible. I'll aim to have the W-9 and a named procurement contact in the portal by 4/27.

Attached: ClearWave_W-9.pdf

Thanks,
Jill Park
Head of Partnerships
ClearWave
[Attachment: ClearWave_W-9.pdf (PDF)]

Tessa / Neha —

Thanks — quick internal take:
- I'll own the Redwood side of the PO/contract once ClearWave has a Coupa supplier ID. I'll start the SOW/contract redline in parallel so we can compress timelines.
- I'll prepare a Coupa field checklist (common required fields + sample values) and share with Jill and Oliver so they can pre-populate. That should knock a week off the intake time for many customers.
- Neha, please prepare provisioning checklist and a test plan (simple smoke test) we can run once their vendor account is live.

I can take point on the Coupa template and SOW; targeting to have both uploaded to the HubSpot deal by EOD Thu (4/22).

Marissa
